scope: Bench fit on the Mark 1 standard-layer front-top Wago receiver coupons.

articles.result: Wago inserts easily and is retained. Fit accepted on the coupon.
articles.observation: So, on the last print there, on the 3.1, the WAGO fits in very easily, but is still held pretty well. It's awesome. The 3.1 is definitely good enough.

articles.result: Wago can be inserted with substantial force. Tightness was reported primarily in Z and possibly in X.
articles.observation: The 4.1, it was just— it's possible to get in there, but it's too tight. It takes quite a bit of force to get it in, particularly in the Z-axis, but also maybe the X-axis a bit.
